Introduction
This procedure details the testing procedures P1, to be carried 
out on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Gaber Salah Taher, tested by eng. Osama 
 Ahmed Hassanain at 30 January 2006, accepted by eng. Mohamed Osama 
Soliman Salim general director, approved by eng. Mohamed Abdel Baset Rekabi Head 
Sector of Aswan Dam 1 Power Station, and certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem: 
 HPGC MPIS coordinator & inspection and quality control general director.
Safety Precautions

 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required.
Wear your safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc.
